slides.heading: Instinct and idea are different things

columns.b: The emotional vein. Something broken in human experience. SMS taxi was right. Tribe.net instincts were right.
One product bet on that instinct. Often a B+. Kill it fast so the A can show up.
The skill that improves with time. If you ask is this it?, you already know.

slides.heading: Proven better new, in order

layers.title: Proven
layers.sub: Find the closest success. Same audience. Deconstruct every pixel.

layers.title: Better
layers.sub: One change the existing audience would all notice.

layers.title: New
layers.sub: The novel hook. Expect it to fail. Isolate the experiment.

slides.sub: Give yourself four shots on goal, not one grind up a hill.

slides.label: retention beats virality in consumer
slides.sub: 40,000 games launched. Zero sustained top 25. People download zero new apps a month. Build for the life stack.
